claims.evidence: Paper: THP-1 grown in light/medium/heavy SILAC media, PMA-differentiated (dTHP-1), each label given one autophagy stimulus; cells from the three treatments pooled, autophagosomes purified, 16% iodixanol fraction 'from three biological replicates' analysed (n = 3). MaxQuant experiments Rep1/Rep2/Rep3. Each source = one labelled culture (one condition) of one biological replicate; no name is reused for two cultures.

claims.value: SILAC light = rapamycin; SILAC medium = Leishmania donovani infection; SILAC heavy = amino acid starvation with bafilomycin A1
claims.evidence: Explicit: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol: 'The “light” cell population was treated with rapamycin, the “medium” cell population was infected with Leishmania donovani, and the “heavy” cell population was amino acid-starved and treated with bafilomycin A1'. Fig 1A shows 'Light (K0R0) Rapamycin', 'Medium (K4R6) L. donovani', 'Heavy (K8R10) Amino Acid Starvation'; S3/S4 Table titles name Leishmania-infected (M), rapamycin-treated (L), starved (H). Data check vs paper Tables 2/3 (log2 Leishmania/rapamycin and Leishmania/starvation means): ALCAM M/L Rep1-3 = -1.66/-1.51/-2.76 (mean -1.98; Table 2 -1.978); SQSTM1 H/M = +2.15/+2.10/+3.06 => M/H mean -2.44 (Table 3 -2.435); PPT1 H/M = -1.48/-2.63/-2.11 => M/H mean +2.07 (Table 3 2.072). Map confirmed, no conflict. Treatments (paper): 12.5 ug/mL rapamycin 2 h; L. donovani promastigotes MOI 20:1 for 24 h; HBSS starvation 4 h with 100 nM bafilomycin A1 for the last 3 h. Treatment values are free text (no single NCIT/EFO term covers the composite stimuli).

claims.value: 1, 2, 3 (restarting in each treatment group; one number per independent culture)
claims.evidence: Paper: 'The 16% iodixanol fraction from three biological replicates were used for LC-MS/MS (n = 3)'. summary.txt experiments Rep1, Rep2, Rep3; file name prefixes 1-, 2-, 3-.
Deposited raw archives (Bruker .d archived as .d.1.dar; campaign precedent PXD052362/PXD058003 use the .dar name). Each file holds all three SILAC channels, so each gives 3 rows.

claims.value: 1-5 (rep1, rep2), 1-3 (rep3), from the gel-slice index in the file name (Eleanor_<rep>-<slice>)
claims.evidence: Paper: 'run on 10% SDS-PAGE. The entire lane was split into 5 fractions'. summary.txt Fraction column agrees for Rep1 and Rep3; for Rep2 MaxQuant assigned 2-2->1, 2-3->2, 2-1->3, 2-4->4, 2-5->5 (the SDRF follows the file-name slice index; MaxQuant fraction numbers only steer match-between-runs).
In-gel fractionation: 10% SDS-PAGE lane cut into 5 fractions, in-gel trypsin digest.
One injection per gel slice; no technical replicates described.

PX species 9606; THP-1 is human (Cellosaurus OX 9606). L. donovani proteins present in the infected channel are recorded via characteristics[infection]; the sample organism is the human host cell line.

claims.evidence: Paper: 'THP-1 cells, obtained from ATCC (TIB-202)'. Cellosaurus CVCL_0006 DR ATCC TIB-202, human (no other-species collision for this name with ATCC TIB-202).
Cellosaurus: 'Derived from site: In situ; Peripheral blood; UBERON=UBERON_0000178'. UBERON:0000178 blood.

Cellosaurus DI NCIt C9163 Childhood acute monocytic leukemia; EFO:1001944 'childhood acute monocytic leukemia' (not obsolete). Note: the local sdrf-tools cellline DB returns 'Childhood acute megakaryoblastic leukemia', which contradicts Cellosaurus and was not used.
Cellosaurus AG 1Y, SX Male, 'Population: Japanese'; HANCESTRO:0019 Japanese. Developmental stage omitted (not adult; rule 9).
Measured cells are PMA-differentiated THP-1 (dTHP-1, 10 ng/mL PMA 16-18 h); the paper calls them macrophages throughout (title 'Leishmania-infected macrophages', 'host macrophages'). CL:0000235.
All samples are cultured THP-1 cells; no blanks or reference channels.
SILAC: L-glutamine/arginine/lysine-deficient RPMI-1640 (Caisson Labs) + 7% dialysed FBS with Lys0/Arg0, Lys4/Arg6 or Lys8/Arg10. NCIT:C178973.
Custom characteristics column (spec 'Extending Templates'; rule 16): every measured sample is the autophagosome-enriched iodixanol gradient fraction 4 (16% iodixanol). GO:0005776.

limitations: Partial deposit: MaxQuant searched 15 raw files (summary.txt), but Eleanor_3-4-300ng_8-1-2021_E6_2734 and Eleanor_3-5-300ng_8-1-2021_E7_2735 (Rep3, gel slices 4 and 5) were never deposited (absent from the FTP listing, checksum.txt and the PX file list). Replicate 3 is therefore annotated with only 3 fractions; the SDRF covers all 13 deposited raw files.

PRIDE REST API returned HTTP 500 / timeouts for most of the session (MCP get_project_details failed); the v3 project record and file list were obtained on a later retry and are cited. The PRIDE structured fields (instrument 'Bruker Daltonics instrument model', organism part 'Cell culture', 'No PTMs') are submitter dropdowns and are superseded by the paper and the search output.

MaxQuant 'Fraction' numbering for Rep2 (2-2->1, 2-3->2, 2-1->3) differs from the gel-slice index in the file names; the SDRF fraction identifier follows the file names (slice order), as Rep1 and Rep3 do in MaxQuant.
Dissociation method (CID) and MS2 analyzer (TOF) are inferred from the instrument type (impact II Q-TOF); the cited acquisition reference [32] was not read and the .dar raw archives were not opened.

Treatment values are free text: no NCIT/EFO term covers 'Leishmania donovani infection' or 'amino acid starvation with bafilomycin A1'; treatment doses/durations are only in this manifest (no licensed column).
cell type 'macrophage' describes PMA-differentiated THP-1 (macrophage-like), as the paper calls them; THP-1 itself is a monocytic line.
